geometryObservations: water is the only pit, so on-foot gaps stay short (1.5-2 u) and the footing does the talking: enemy on it, lateral motion, vertical motion, one-shot bounce
the first landing already carries the first enemy: spin just before landing is the opening lesson (POINT 1)
moving footing escalates by axis: lateral disc, floating discs with air steering, sinking hippo, one bobbing pillar, a submerging pair, the death route's no-stop pillars
the one-tile aisle is used twice: piranhas plus a crate block in S1, piranhas plus Nitro at both ends in the final causeway
mines teach by subversion: static pack, left-right sweeper, a pair of moving mines, then circling mines that punish the learned dodge
board hazards narrow a wide lane four ways (walls, mines, whirlpools, Nitro lane); crates lie on the safe line
board height comes only from kickers; the course loops so a missed ramp crate costs a lap, not a life
the board cannot backtrack, so on-foot detours sit at the boarding piers
crates are disappearing bridges: water crates to the warp tile, striped crates under lives, the bonus outline stair
enemies are stationary or rhythmic, never chasers: plants guard landings, piranhas pulse across lanes, the hippo is footing
a checkpoint sits on every pier where the mode changes; the death route is offered only to no-death players
geometryTransfer: spin-on-landing pad: 2-2.5 m pads over a pit, a grunt on the first landing, 2.3 m gap so the landing is the test
disappearing crate bridge: five crates 3-4 m apart over a pit to a secret ledge (stomp chain on foot; touching crate row = one-way grind bridge on the board), placed before the board pickup
patroller fake-out: two floaters sweeping left-right (enemies patrol along X), then an out-of-phase pair covering the learned dodge side so it fails; keep a clear centre line for a boosting rider
kicker crates on a looping lane, floating 1.5-2.5 m above each kicker arc, no pit under the landing
phasepad stepping posts 1.5-2 m spaced 2 m apart: one alone, then a pair; keep them off board lines
Nitro lane (two lines of 3, 3 m lane) right after a gate of two patrolling floaters on a 20-30 m straight
